title: gastrochilus pusillus
intro: Gastrochilus pusillus, commonly known as the "Dwarf Orchid", is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus pusillus include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and exhibiting potential antiviral and antibacterial activities. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
